description: Figure: conservation of the IFT54 tubulin-binding basic surface at DYF-11 positions, and IFT54 contact replicate across anterograde and retrograde train structures
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Figure: conservation of the IFT54 tubulin-binding basic surface mapped onto DYF-11
# (values recomputed here from the same pipeline as the previous cell)
rows = [("R7",4,"E",False,6),("R8",5,"E",False,10),("K15",12,"K",True,9),("R18",15,"Q",False,9),
        ("R19",16,"K",True,15),("K25",22,"Q",False,12),("K29",26,"R",True,16),("R33",30,"K",True,17),
        ("R44",41,"K",True,8),("K50",47,"K",True,12),("K59",56,"K",True,6),("K64",60,"N",False,6),
        ("K66",62,"K",True,16),("K69",65,"K",True,17),("K91",85,"K",True,17),("R94",88,"K",True,15),
        ("R103",97,"E",False,6),("K113",107,"T",False,5),("K118",112,"F",False,4),("K126",124,"K",True,11),
        ("R127",125,"K",True,12)]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["mouse","dyf11_pos","dyf11_aa","conserved_basic","n_basic_orthologs"])
df["pct"]=100*df.n_basic_orthologs/17

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.6,1]})
ax=axes[0]
cols=["#2f855a" if c else "#a0aec0" for c in df.conserved_basic]
ax.bar(range(len(df)),df.pct,color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(df)))
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{m}\n{a}{p}" for m,p,a in zip(df.mouse,df.dyf11_pos,df.dyf11_aa)],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("orthologs with Lys/Arg at this position (%)")
ax.set_xlabel("mouse IFT54 CH surface-exposed basic residue (top) and aligned DYF-11 residue (bottom)")
ax.axhline(50,color="#cbd5e0",ls="--",lw=0.8)
ax.set_title("Tubulin-binding basic surface of the IFT54 CH domain:\nconservation at DYF-11 positions across 17 IFT54 orthologs",fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0,105)
ax.text(0.98,0.04,"green: DYF-11 keeps Lys/Arg (13 of 21)\ngrey: DYF-11 substitutes a non-basic residue",
        transform=ax.transAxes,ha="right",fontsize=8,color="#4a5568")

ax=axes[1]
# contact replicate: 8BD7 vs 8RUY atom pairs per partner (computed values)
part=["IFT20","IFT80","CLUAP1/IFT38","IFT172","IFT57"]
ant=[1224+1189, 195+239, 172+191, 2, 78]
ret=[1354+1472, 458+719, 246+221, 74+117+10, 0]
x=np.arange(len(part)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,ant,w,label="anterograde train (8BD7, 9.9 A)",color="#3182ce")
ax.bar(x+w/2,ret,w,label="retrograde train (8RUY, 15.4 A)",color="#dd6b20")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(part,rotation=20,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("IFT54 inter-chain heavy-atom pairs < 5 A\n(sum of both train repeats)")
ax.set_title("IFT54 direct contacts in Chlamydomonas IFT trains",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_yscale("symlog",linthresh=10)
for xi,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(ant,ret)):
    ax.text(xi-w/2,a*1.15,str(a),ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
    ax.text(xi+w/2,max(b,1)*1.15,str(b),ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nDYF-11 positions basic in >=15/17 orthologs:", list(df[(df.conserved_basic)&(df.n_basic_orthologs>=15)].apply(lambda r:f"{r.dyf11_aa}{r.dyf11_pos}",axis=1)))
